original_ai_prompt: We're fitting out a new office with smart lighting — a handful of network-controlled LED units. Put the normal office PCs on their own network and wire in the smart lights as IoT devices, keeping the lights off the staff network. Everything should get its IP automatically. Cable internet is fine.
